steps.name: live-outbox-relay-publisher-wiring
steps.summary: Implemented build_live_worker_runtime_from_env to construct OutboxRelayWorker using lazy _TransactionalOutboxRelayRepository wrapping PostgreSQL and KafkaProducerPublisher without establishing network sockets during import/setup.

steps.name: live-kafka-consumer-worker-wiring
steps.summary: Implemented LazyKafkaConsumerClient to lazily import kafka-python and construct KafkaConsumer. Wired Checkout, Inventory, Payment, and Store Approval listeners using _TransactionalListener to guarantee transactional boundaries per message handoff. Verified offset commit on success and rollback on failure.

steps.name: worker-cli-compose-live-boundary
steps.summary: Updated dispatch_command and _command_from_args in entrypoint.py to parse live worker CLI flags (--live, --dry-run, --once, --loop, --confirm-live-worker). Configured token_payments_live_worker service in docker-compose.yml to run loops on confirmed startup.

steps.name: kafka-live-smoke-public-verification
steps.summary: Added test_kafka_live_worker_public_contracts.py to verify live worker service definitions in docker-compose.yml and documented command line options. Updated README.md and docs/HARNESS.md with setup instructions for live execution (--live, --once, --loop, --confirm-live-worker).
